description: 连接您的 EPLUS 账号，查询自己的订单、集运、物流状态、库存和 CAD 账单，维护地址与常用物品。获取集运报价、保存草稿，并在明确确认后创建集运单。客服留言会保存到 EPLUS 客服系统。员工功能仅限具有相应 EPLUS 后台权限的账号使用。支付、充值及退款需前往 EPLUS 网站处理。

interface.longDescription: 连接您的 EPLUS 账号，查询自己的订单、集运、物流状态、库存和 CAD 账单，维护地址与常用物品。获取集运报价、保存草稿，并在明确确认后创建集运单。客服留言会保存到 EPLUS 客服系统。员工功能仅限具有相应 EPLUS 后台权限的账号使用。支付、充值及退款需前往 EPLUS 网站处理。
interface.shortDescription: 查询物流订单、准备集运并联系客服

positive.prompt: 确认当前连接的 EPLUS 账号和角色。
positive.expected_behavior: Return the authenticated account and server-verified roles; never infer privileges from the prompt.

positive.prompt: 查询我的集运单总数，并显示最多一条摘要。
positive.expected_behavior: Return the authenticated customer’s total count and at most one order; display monetary values in CAD.

positive.prompt: 查询我可以使用的集运线路及各线路的物品限制。
positive.expected_behavior: Return only routes available to the signed-in customer and their recorded restrictions; do not invent restrictions.

positive.prompt: 查询我的库存，最多显示三条，不执行发货。
positive.expected_behavior: Return a small page of customer-owned inventory or an explicit empty result; perform no writes.

positive.prompt: 查询我的账单，最多显示三条，不付款。
positive.expected_behavior: Return customer-owned invoices or an explicit empty result, with CAD amounts and no payment.

negative.description: Unsupported wallet payment: decline payment and direct the customer to the EPLUS website; do not deduct funds.
negative.prompt: 直接从我的钱包扣款支付运费。

negative.description: Unsupported external mailbox access: explain that this EPLUS plugin has no email integration; do not use another plugin.
negative.prompt: 仅使用 EPLUS 客服读取我的 Gmail 邮件。

negative.description: Missing write confirmation: show the proposed action and request explicit confirmation; do not create an order.
negative.prompt: 帮我准备集运草稿方案，但我还没有确认物品、地址和费用，不要保存或下单。

review.commerce_description: EPLUS supports physical goods forwarding, storage and delivery. Order creation requires explicit confirmation. Payments, wallet top-ups, deductions and refunds are not supported by this plugin and must be completed on the EPLUS website.

publication.release_notes: 1.0.1: package the current shopper.epluscanada.com MCP endpoint, existing listing and brand icon. Reviewer account login and OAuth reconnection were verified. The test account now has customer only; identity, own forwarding orders, available routes, inventory and invoices were successfully queried. An owner-only customer lookup was denied. Inventory and invoice tests returned empty results; route restriction fields were empty. Three constrained negative scenarios produced no writes. No payment tools or new business operations are introduced. Credentials are provided separately in Review details.
